messages:
Maria Chen: Hey — I sketched a compact launch snapshot (1 pager) aimed at CISOs and platform/infra leads. Primary goals: 1) give field a security-forward artifact to hand off, 2) include a short benchmark blurb for execs, 3) include clear inbound lead routing + tags for SDRs. Need review + signoff by Thu EOD.

Josh Patel: Thanks. Can you drop the link? I'll scan for product claims that need legal review.

Maria Chen: Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/ciso-snapshot-draft (internal) — pasted key sections below.

Maria Chen: TL;DR: Redwood Inference gives predictable low-latency LLM inference for regulated teams via private deployments (VPC/on-prem), dedicated SLA-backed capacity, and audited key management. Typical win: 2–5x lower p95 latency vs cloud-hosted single-replica endpoints in our internal benchmark, and explicit routable fallbacks for capacity events.

Anya Sokolova: Nice start. Two asks: (1) add a one-line security controls checklist (KMS, audit logs, network controls) and (2) a short recommended subject line and 2 email openers for field outreach.

Lee Nguyen: Also add exact lead routing tags — SDRs need to know which queue to drop into. Suggested tags: security-led, sla-request, private-deploy, gov-cloud. Add routing: security-led -> Solutions AE, sla-request -> Enterprise AE, private-deploy -> Platform Solutions.

Maria Chen: OK — adding both. Draft subject lines: "CISO Brief: Production-grade LLM inference with VPC SLAs" and "Reduce LLM latency & meet compliance — Redwood private deployments". Email openers: 1) "Quick note for your security team — we run LLM inference inside customer VPCs with KMS + audit logs." 2) "Curious if your platform team has evaluated SLA-backed inference for latency-sensitive flows — would love 15m."

Josh Patel: For the benchmark blurb we should avoid absolute numbers unless we can cite the test. Suggest: "In-house benchmarks show significant p95 latency improvements on representative customer workloads; contact us for a tailored benchmark run."

Maria Chen: Good call. Revised benchmark blurb: "Representative internal benchmarks show measurable p95 latency gains and cost improvements when using Dedicated or Private modes; we offer a tailored evaluation with your workloads."

Anya Sokolova: Security checklist (one-line bullets to include on the 1-pager): - Customer-managed KMS & HSM support; - Audit logs & SIEM integration; - VPC-only control plane option; - Dedicated tenancy & network isolation. Keep each as a 3–4 word phrase.

Lee Nguyen: For inbound routing, propose a simple mapping table for SDRs (include in doc footer): tags -> owner -> priority. Example: security-led -> Solutions AE -> P1, private-deploy -> Platform Solutions -> P2, sla-request -> Enterprise AE -> P1.

Maria Chen: I added the table and shortened language for the one-pager. Also added a webinar CTA: "Join our 30-min CISO fireside on Apr 12 — live demo of VPC deploy + SLA routing." Use that as a follow-up touch in emails.

Josh Patel: Quick legal nit: change 'guaranteed' to 'SLA-backed' where applicable.

Maria Chen: Done.

ops-bot: Document uploaded to marketing assets: /assets/ciso-snapshot-2176543210.pdf :page_facing_up:

Lee Nguyen: Approving language for field. One suggestion: add a single customer quote (anonymized) — "We adopted private deployments to meet compliance and saw improved latency" — keeps it neutral.

Maria Chen: Adding anonymized quote. Final ask: can SalesOps wire the routing tags into SFDC lead rules? If yes, we can flip this live at launch.

Lee Nguyen: I'll ping SalesOps now.

Anya Sokolova: LGTM from security side.

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone — locking the doc. I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow for final handoff and export the one-pager to the field kit. :thumbsup:
